newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles voters approve fire, library funding.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles voters approve fire, library funding.

text.p: Voters in Los Angeles County approved measures to continue funding of fire and library services, county election officials said on Wednesday.
Proposition E, which provides $51.7 million to the county fire department, was approved in Tuesday's special election with 77.22 percent support.
Voters also approved a $9 million library funding measure, Proposition L, with 69.85 percent support.
The two measures were placed on the ballot because of California's Proposition 218, which strengthened existing law to require that local taxes be submitted to voters.
